summary: __thiscall double-valued getter: computes a scaled performance-counter difference from this via PerformanceCounterDiffWithScaling (0x00568D90), adds the read-only global double dbl_8AFEA0 (0x008AFEA0), and returns the sum. Called by SessionSynchronizer (0x0045F950). The ABI name Time_Offset_Getter and the caller context are consistent with a time-offset (session clock offset) readout, but that semantic rests on the caller, not on this packet.

local_names.this: receiver object whose per-object counter state is consumed by PerformanceCounterDiffWithScaling
local_names.dbl_8AFEA0: read-only global double offset at 0x008AFEA0 added to the scaled counter diff

operations.description: Compute the scaled performance-counter difference for this via PerformanceCounterDiffWithScaling (0x00568D90).
Add the read-only global double dbl_8AFEA0 (0x008AFEA0) to the scaled counter difference.
Return the resulting double sum as the getter result.
Invoked by SessionSynchronizer (0x0045F950), which reads the resulting time offset.

unresolved: Meaning of the additive global dbl_8AFEA0 (a session start time, a fixed offset, or a per-session bias) is not determinable from this packet alone.
